actions: Reject any fault-injection value in the candidate Deployment.
Require the normal value DEMO_ERROR_RATE=0.
cases.analysis: A release that sets DEMO_ERROR_RATE to a non-zero value injects deliberate /work 500 responses and is a hard release risk.
cautions: Do not treat a recovered local drill as approval for shipping fault settings.
cases.excerpt: - 500：`DEMO_ERROR_RATE=1`，真实请求日志返回 500；触发 DemoHighErrorRate，恢复为 200 后收到同指纹 resolved。
cases.rollback: Restore DEMO_ERROR_RATE=0 and wait for a healthy rollout before considering the release again.
cases.title: HTTP 500 故障注入

actions: Reject non-zero DEMO_LATENCY_MS.
Review p95 latency separately from probe health.
cases.analysis: A release that sets DEMO_LATENCY_MS above zero injects business latency; readiness/liveness probes themselves are not delayed, so probes passing does not make the release safe.
cautions: Do not infer low latency from healthy probes.
cases.excerpt: - 慢请求：`DEMO_LATENCY_MS=3000`，请求日志耗时约 3.00–3.01 秒；触发 DemoP95LatencyHigh，恢复后收到 resolved。
cases.rollback: Restore DEMO_LATENCY_MS=0 and verify the 5m p95 returns below the review threshold.
cases.title: 3000ms 慢请求故障注入

actions: Reject DEMO_STARTUP_FAIL=true.
Separate old-Pod availability from new-Pod health and version verification.
cases.analysis: A startup-failure drill demonstrates maxUnavailable=0/maxSurge=1 release protection; it does not prove that the new version works, and the old Pod still serving is not new-version provenance.
cautions: Do not claim a successful release because the old Pod stayed Ready.
cases.excerpt: - 启动失败：新 Pod 输出 StartupError/`startup_failed`、CrashLoopBackOff，旧 Pod 保持 Ready 并返回 200；触发 DemoPodCrashLooping。这是发布保护，不是全服务中断。
cases.rollback: Restore DEMO_STARTUP_FAIL=false, roll out a healthy new Pod, and verify endpoints and version separately.
cases.title: 启动失败只验证滚动发布保护

actions: Use firing and resolved evidence as context, not as a release approval.
Do not claim recovery when the resolved fingerprint is absent.
cases.analysis: Alert recovery evidence must match the firing alert by fingerprint; unrelated or missing resolved events are insufficient.
cautions: A local webhook notification is not production notification reliability.
cases.excerpt:
- 500：`DEMO_ERROR_RATE=1`，真实请求日志返回 500；触发 DemoHighErrorRate，恢复为 200 后收到同指纹 resolved。
- 慢请求：`DEMO_LATENCY_MS=3000`，请求日志耗时约 3.00–3.01 秒；触发 DemoP95LatencyHigh，恢复后收到 resolved。
cases.rollback: Recover the injected condition and verify a matching resolved event.
cases.title: 告警 firing 与同指纹 resolved

actions: Preserve PVC identity, timestamp, and marker evidence in reports.
Do not interpret local-path persistence as HA or backup.
cases.analysis: Persistence evidence is tied to unchanged PVCs and exact query timestamps, not to a vague claim that storage survived.
cautions: Single worker local-path storage is not replicated and can be lost with the node disk.
cases.excerpt: - 数据持久化：见 `evidence/persistence.json`。Prometheus 与 Loki Pod UID 均改变，原 PVC 相同；固定查询时间的指标值仍为 67，重建前 marker 的原时间戳和日志全文完全相同。
cases.rollback: Restore the workload and re-query the same fixed time and marker.
cases.title: Pod 重建后 PVC 持久化

actions: Require new-Pod-specific readiness and version evidence.
Do not collapse rollout success into Service availability.
cases.analysis: During a rolling update an old Ready Pod can keep the Service available while the new Pod is not yet proven; endpoints, image digest, and /version must be verified.
cautions: Do not use Service 200 responses alone as new-version proof.
cases.excerpt: 发现并修复：Service port-forward 随旧 Pod 退出；Windows 复制的恢复脚本缺少执行位；Shell 同一 local 声明引用未赋值变量；滚动发布时旧 Pod Ready 不能证明新版本完成。Alloy 配置先通过自身 validate，再检查实际日志流。
cases.rollback: Roll back through Git desired state and verify the resulting image and /version.
cases.title: 旧 Pod Ready 不能证明新版本完成

actions: Keep SLO claims out of release approval unless the full window exists.
Report only observed metrics and their timestamps.
cases.analysis: A short drill window cannot prove a 7-day SLO or a percentage improvement; reports must state the evidence boundary.
cases.excerpt: 告警只验证本地 webhook 通知链路。Prometheus 7 天 SLO 目标为 99.9%，本次未积累完整 7 天窗口，不宣称 SLO 已达标，也不编造恢复效率提升百分比。
cases.rollback: Collect a complete window before making an SLO claim.
cases.title: SLO 声明边界

actions: Wait for new Pod readiness before judging fault effect.
Record the exact rollout and readiness timestamps.
cases.analysis: A drill fault is effective only after rollout and new-Pod readiness; an old Pod still serving can hide the injected condition.
cautions: Do not mark a drill effective solely because a patch was submitted.
cases.excerpt:
### 3.1 错误率（100% /work 500）

```bash
scripts/drills/inject.sh --fault error --suspend-gitops
# 观察告警/指标/日志，例如：
#   sum(rate(demo_http_requests_total{route="/work",status=~"5.."}[5m]))
#   kubectl -n demo logs deploy/demo --tail=50
scripts/drills/recover.sh
```

env：`DEMO_ERROR_RATE=1`，并确保 latency/startup 为正常值。rollout 完成、
新 Pod Ready 后才记录 `fault_fully_effective=true`。
cases.rollback: Run recover.sh and wait for rollout, /healthz, and /readyz.
cases.title: 错误率演练需等待新 Pod Ready

actions: Check the business p95 metric, not only probe status.
Reject non-zero latency injection values.
cases.analysis: The demo deliberately keeps health probes fast during latency injection, so passing probes are not evidence of low business latency.
cautions: Do not infer business performance from probe success.
cases.excerpt:
env：`DEMO_LATENCY_MS=3000`。`/healthz`、`/readyz` 不注入延迟，避免探针误杀；
业务延迟看 histogram：

```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95,
  sum by (le) (rate(demo_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/work"}[5m])))
```
cases.rollback: Restore DEMO_LATENCY_MS=0 and watch the histogram p95 recover.
cases.title: 探针不注入延迟

actions: Reject DEMO_STARTUP_FAIL=true.
Account for retained old Pod plus surge Pod in capacity checks.
cases.analysis: The chart rolling strategy retains the old Ready Pod while a failing new Pod is replaced; this is release protection, not proof the new revision works.
cautions: Do not manufacture business outage by scaling or deleting Pods as part of this drill.
cases.excerpt:
### 3.3 启动失败（验证发布保护，不是业务全停）

```bash
scripts/drills/inject.sh --fault startup-failure --suspend-gitops
scripts/drills/recover.sh
```

env：`DEMO_STARTUP_FAIL=true`。应用会打印明确的 `startup_failed` 日志并退出
（受 liveness/readiness 影响，新 Pod 进入 CrashLoop）。**不要**把
`kubectl rollout status` 失败直接记录成“启动故障完全生效”：

- Chart 使用 `maxUnavailable: 0` / `maxSurge: 1`；
- 新 Pod 失败时，旧 Pod 仍保持 Ready 并继续服务；
- 因此这项演练验证的是**滚动发布保护**，不是制造业务不可用；
- 脚本观察新 Pod/事件/日志，记录 `old_pod_still_serving`、
  `fault_fully_effective=false`、`release_protection_observed`。

如果确实需要验证“业务不可用”，必须另行设计**明确、可恢复**的演练（例如显式
scale deployment），并单独评审恢复步骤；本目录脚本不会偷偷删 Pod/scale 或制造
不可控中断。
cases.rollback: Restore normal startup and verify the new Pod image digest and /version.
cases.title: 启动失败时旧 Pod 仍服务

actions: Treat every recovery step as required evidence.
Do not restore only selected env values when full state is available.
cases.analysis: Recovery restores the exact prior env, waits for rollout, verifies health, restores Argo auto-sync, and records a recovered event; any step failing returns non-zero.
cautions: The fallback cannot restore the original Argo auto-sync value.
cases.excerpt:
## 4. 恢复语义

`recover.sh` 顺序：

1. 从 state 读取注入前的完整 container `env`，用 JSON patch 精确恢复；失败则
   回退为 `DEMO_ERROR_RATE=0 DEMO_LATENCY_MS=0 DEMO_STARTUP_FAIL=false`；
2. 等待 Deployment rollout（带总超时）；
3. 通过 port-forward 检查 `/healthz` 和 `/readyz`，记录成功 UTC；
4. 恢复 `argocd/demo` 的原 auto-sync 并校验；
5. 写 `recovered` JSONL；任何一步失败返回非 0。

```bash
# 最近一次
scripts/drills/recover.sh
# 指定状态
scripts/drills/recover.sh --state scripts/drills/.state/<drill-id>.json
# 状态丢失的兜底（只把三个 DEMO_* 设正常，无法恢复 Argo 原值）
scripts/drills/recover.sh --force-normal
```

恢复不会删除 state；需要保留证据。再次 recover 是幂等的。
cases.rollback: Use the stored state file; fall back to forcing the three DEMO_* values normal only when state is lost.
cases.title: 故障恢复顺序

actions: Recommend a revert commit and Argo resync.
Verify the resulting Application revision, image, and /version.
cases.analysis: A GitOps rollback is a revert commit to Git, not argocd app rollback or kubectl rollout undo. The image tag must remain immutable.
cautions: Do not claim GitOps rollback from an imperative cluster-only operation.
cases.excerpt:
## 6. Git 回滚流程

演练 `recover.sh` 只恢复本地被 patch 的 env，不等于 GitOps 回滚。需要回滚发布时：

```bash
git revert <bad-desired-state-commit>
git push origin main
# 等待 Argo 同步；核对
kubectl -n demo rollout status deployment/demo --timeout=180s
```

**禁止**只执行 `argocd app rollback` 或 `kubectl rollout undo` 后就声称完成了
GitOps 回滚；Argo CD 的历史/自愈不能替代 Git desired state 的 revert commit。
GitOps 的 `targetRevision: main` 是 Git 分支，不是镜像 `latest`；镜像 tag 必须
是不可变 `sha-<commit>`。
cases.rollback: git revert the bad desired-state commit, push main, wait for Argo sync, then verify rollout and endpoints.
signals: do not use argocd app rollback as substitute
cases.title: GitOps 回退必须改变 Git desired state

actions: Represent unknown alert state explicitly and do not treat it as healthy.
Require actual output before confirming root cause.
cases.analysis: If the alert receiver is unavailable or the response cannot be parsed, alert_fired stays null; the runbook does not guess that no alert fired.
cautions: Do not write a root-cause confirmation without observed metrics, logs, or alert IDs.
cases.excerpt:
规则：

- UTC 故障开始、alert 观测、rollout 完成、health 成功都有独立时间字段。
- `alert_fired` 仅当 receiver API 实际查询成功且能判定时是 true/false；
  未配置、不可达、非 2xx、响应无法解析时一律 `null`，**不猜测未告警**。
  receiver 支持 Alertmanager 风格 `{"alerts":[...]}`（匹配 namespace/deployment/
  app/service=demo 且 status=firing），或 `{"firing":true|false}`。
- `root_cause_confirmed` 默认始终是 `false`，脚本不会自动声称根因。
  操作者实际核对指标、日志、告警后，用：

```bash
scripts/drills/record.sh \
  --drill-id '<drill-id>' \
  --command 'sum(rate(demo_http_requests_total{route="/work",status=~"5.."}[5m])) + logs' \
  --evidence '实际观测到的数值/日志/告警 ID' \
  --confirmed
```

不加 `--confirmed` 只追加未确认的观测证据。没有实际输出不要写确认。
cases.rollback: Re-query a reachable receiver and record actual evidence before changing the claim.
cases.title: 告警未知时不得猜测

actions: Use only Ready, schedulable non-control-plane workers for capacity.
Reserve resources for retained old Pods and surge Pods.
cases.analysis: Capacity reasoning depends on Ready, schedulable workers and retained control-plane taints; a single worker leaves little room for surge during rolling updates.
cautions: Do not count the control-plane node as schedulable worker capacity.
cases.excerpt:
- API `/readyz`。
- 恰好 2 个节点，`master`/`worker` 均 Ready，InternalIP 分别为 `11.0.1.10`/`11.0.1.11`，容器运行时为 containerd。
- kubeadm `podSubnet` 与 Calico 默认 IPv4 IPPool 均为 `10.244.0.0/16`。
- kube-apiserver、controller-manager、scheduler、etcd Ready。
- kube-proxy、calico-node、calico-kube-controllers、CoreDNS Ready。
- `kubernetes` Service 为 `10.96.0.1`，`kube-dns` 为 `10.96.0.10`。
- master 的 control-plane taint 仍存在，Calico 有 `Exists` toleration。
- 创建临时 master/worker 测试 Pod（固定 `busybox:1.36.1`，无 latest），验证：
  - 两 Pod 获得不同 Pod IP；
  - 集群 DNS 解析 `kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local`；
  - master→worker 和 worker→master 双向 ICMP 跨节点 Pod 网络。
- 退出时删除临时命名空间；不删除 taint，不执行 reset。
cases.rollback: Free capacity or reduce the rollout demand; do not remove the control-plane taint as a workaround.

cases.title: 单 worker 容量与 Ready 检查

actions: Keep troubleshooting read-only and evidence-based.
Do not bypass readiness by removing taints.
cases.analysis: When networking Pods are not Ready, inspect Pods, logs, and CIDR instead of deleting the control-plane taint or changing image tags to latest.
cautions: Do not use latest or skip checks to make an acceptance pass.
cases.excerpt:
| 现象 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| `admin.conf` 存在但版本为 1.28 或 `/readyz` 失败 | 停止。操作者在 playbook 外清理旧集群；本仓库不会自动 reset。 |
| 只有 `kube-apiserver.yaml`，无 `admin.conf` | 停止。检查部分初始化状态，不要直接删除证书或再次 init。 |
| worker `kubelet.conf` 存在但 API server/Node/IP 不匹配 | 停止。该 enrollment 不属于目标集群，按操作者流程清理后再 join。 |
| containerd 启动失败或 CRI 插件未加载 | 检查 `/etc/containerd/config.toml`（v3）和 `journalctl -u containerd`；不得回退到旧 2.2.3 配置。 |
| Calico Pod 不 Ready | 检查 `kubectl -n kube-system get pods -o wide`、Calico 日志、Pod CIDR 是否为 `10.244.0.0/16`；不要删除 master taint 来代替排查。 |
| 测试镜像拉取失败 | 记录网络/镜像仓库错误；不要改成 `latest` 或跳过跨节点网络检查来宣告通过。 |
cases.rollback: Restore the identified networking fault before retrying the release.
